Bill.BriefDescription: Convening a stakeholder group to discuss certain recording deeds of trust issues.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recording residential real property; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A stakeholder group comprised of homeowneradvocates, lenders and their servicers, representatives of countygovernments, and representatives of electronic registry systems are toconvene to discuss the issue of recording deeds of trust of residentialreal property, including assignments and transfers, amongst otherrelated issues. The stakeholder group is to provide at least onespecific legislative proposal to the legislature by December 1, 2012.
